_doc: Sonar attack-toolkit signature database. Each signature flags an AP whose beacon matches a known offensive-tool default. Override locally at /etc/phantom/sonar-signatures.json. Discipline: every entry must cite a public source. Prefer empty over false-positive.

signatures.name: WiFi Pineapple

signatures.source: Hak5 Pineapple Mark V-VII firmware default config — public Hak5 docs

signatures.description: PineAP module advertises SSIDs starting with PineAP

signatures.name: WiFi Pineapple

signatures.name: Free Public WiFi (historic worm / Mana template)

signatures.source: Microsoft Windows XP worm artifact + sensepost/mana templates
